component.name: RecGo
component.summary: Screen and webcam recorder for GNOME

description.p: RecGo is a GTK4/Libadwaita screen, window, and webcam recorder with live draggable webcam shapes, drop shadows, hardware encoding (VP9, H.264, H.265, AV1), and GNOME Shell integration.

screenshot.caption: RecGo studio window with calm Libadwaita header, draggable webcam PiP, and transport controls
On-stage countdown overlay before recording begins
Preferences dialog with countdown presets, hardware video encoder selection, and GPU pipeline status

description.p: Release v0.3.2 introduces Multi-Screen recording, improved Cam + Window capture, Multi-Microphone live mute, a simplified Kdenlive-inspired Edit Mode, and a refreshed vector icon:

ul.li: Multi-Screen Recording: Select multiple monitors or displays at once via the Wayland ScreenCast portal and composite them automatically with live multi-display preview.

Cam + Window App Recording: Aspect-ratio preserving window capture with dynamic resize handling on both OpenGL and CPU compositors, plus automatic source refresh when switching between Monitor and Window.
Multi-Microphone Mixer & Live Mute: Synchronized 48 kHz multi-mic mixing with live mute/unmute during active recordings and reliable device deselection in Preferences.

Simplified In-App Edit Mode: Switch to Edit mode (or click Edit on the recording-saved toast) to browse clips in the Project Bin, scrub the V1/A1 timeline, set In/Out trim points, mark splits, and export trimmed videos.
Refreshed Vector Icon & Complete Papirus Fallback: Updated application icon across all resolutions and bundled all symbolic UI icons in GResource for consistent rendering on any GNOME theme.
Libadwaita UI Polish & Memory Safety: Streamlined action bar buttons, removed duplicate preferences controls, and hardened GStreamer pad-probe reference counting.

description.p: Release v0.3.1 fixes Flatpak startup crashes when an outdated GSettings schema is present:

ul.li: Safe GSettings Fallback: Wraps GLib.Settings reads, writes, and bindings with schema key checks and in-memory fallback defaults so outdated Flatpak wrapper schemas (missing keys like webcam-border) never trigger a fatal GLib-GIO-ERROR on launch.

description.p: Release v0.3.0 fixes webcam mask compositing in recordings, adds live webcam image enhancements, and optimizes reliability on older hardware:

ul.li: Masked Webcam Recording: Bakes Circle, Rounded Square, and Rounded Rectangle SDF masks, borders, and drop shadows directly into recorded video across both GPU and CPU compositors.
Webcam Image FX: Adds live Mirror, Auto Low-Light Enhance, Digital Zoom, Brightness, Contrast, Exposure/Gamma, Warmth, Saturation, Sharpness, Temporal Noise Reduction, and quick presets.
Older Hardware Reliability: Adds Performance Profiles (Older Hardware 720p, Balanced, High Quality), Target FPS capping, fragmented crash-safe MP4 output, and automatic GPU-to-CPU fallback.

description.p: Release v0.2.0 migrates RecGo to native Vala, C, and Meson optimized for GNOME 51:

ul.li: Native Vala + C Engine: Replaces the Rust/Tokio stack with native GLib/GDBus portals and a C GStreamer core for minimal footprint and faster startup.
Multi-Cam & Multi-Mic Handling: Live GstDeviceMonitor hotplug discovery and simultaneous multi-camera compositing and multi-microphone audiomixer support.

GNOME 51 & Performance Optimizations: Event-driven preview frame delivery, OpenGL glvideomixer compositing, synchronized device teardown, persistent GSettings, and GNOME Shell 51 panel indicator support.

description.p: Release v0.1.6 bundles Papirus symbolic icons inside the application resource archive:

ul.li: Bundled Symbolic Icons: Embeds required Papirus symbolic SVG icons via GResource so header bar and transport controls render regardless of the host desktop icon theme.

description.p: Release v0.1.5 refreshes the visual identity and standardizes Flatpak AppStream packaging:

ul.li: Redesigned Application Icon: Introduces a pure-vector faceted crystal icon matching the Imladris visual family while preserving RecGo's monitor and red record emblem.
Standardized Application ID: Updates the application ID to io.github.Antux912012.RecGo across D-Bus, GSettings, desktop entry, and Flatpak metadata.
Embedded Flatpak AppStream Screenshots: Composes AppStream XML and icons inside the Flatpak bundle so screenshots and release notes appear in GNOME Software and Discover upon installation.

description.p: Release v0.1.4 redesigns the studio interface for GNOME/Libadwaita HIG compliance and scientist-friendly workflows:

ul.li: Calm 3-Zone HeaderBar: Consolidates webcam shape and countdown into a progressive-disclosure popover and moves Preferences and About into the standard primary menu.
Expanded Preview Stage: Replaces the permanent top banner with a subtle centered empty-state guide and adds a clear Select Source transport button.
Viewfinder & Preferences Polish: Fixes OSD badge contrast, updates the developer name to Antonio De Gaetano, and adds AppStream screenshots for FlatPark and software centers.

description.p: Release v0.1.3 fixes webcam device detection, PipeWire file descriptor leaks, window lifecycle cleanup, and Preferences UI rendering:

ul.li: Security and Validation: Validates V4L2 device paths and output paths before building GStreamer pipelines.
Lifecycle and Leak Fixes: Cleans up timers, preview feeds, and active recording pipelines on window close, and eliminates cloned PipeWire file descriptor leaks.
UI/UX Fixes: Fixes Pango markup escaping in Preferences, prevents duplicate custom countdown dialogs, and ellipsizes long status paths in the bottom bar.

description.p: Added countdown timer option before recording (3s, 5s, 10s, or custom up to 5 minutes) and preserved webcam frame and live view framing in recorded videos.
Fix crash on recording trigger by resolving PipeWire socket contention and V4L2 device conflicts.
Initial release of RecGo with GPU acceleration, live camera preview, viewfinder OSD, and Preferences dialog.
